canada.title: Heavy snow snarls traffic in Calgary, downs trees in southern Alberta
canada.summary: A major overnight snowfall led to dozens of collisions and detoured bus routes on Calgary roads Wednesday morning. Meanwhile, downed trees led to power outages in Lethbridge and the surrounding area, and school closures.

canada.title: First Nations health watchdog investigating how Sask. boy lost use of small intestine after routine surgery
canada.summary: Saskatchewan's First Nations Health Ombudsperson is investigating how an Indigenous boy from Regina lost his small intestine after a routine surgery for appendicitis.

canada.title: High school students across N.B. walk out over cellphone ban
canada.summary: Hundreds of students at New Brunswick high schools walked out Wednesday afternoon to protest against the coming broader ban on cellphones in schools.

canada.title: Big boost for Buchwald
canada.summary: Adam Buchwald’s competitive speedskating career was in serious jeopardy last November.

canada.title: Coroner’s inquest to be held into 2021 death of Campbell River First Nations man
canada.summary: Relatives of Jared Lowndes, a member of the Laksilyu Clan who lived in Campbell River, say he was shot and killed by unnamed Mounties at a local Tim Hortons on July 8, 2021.
canada.outlet: Global News, CityNews + CBC News + CP24 (CP), Vancouver Sun

canada.title: RCMP arrest 119 people, lay 89 charges during 5-week operation in Pelican Narrows, Sask.
canada.summary: RCMP say 29 officers were deployed to Pelican Narrows, Sask., over a five-week period to arrest violent offenders and cut into the community's drug trade.

canada.title: Jury soon to begin deliberation on Saint John man accused of killing wife in 2024
canada.summary: A Saint John judge has started giving a jury instructions on a man charged with second-degree murder in the death of his wife on Christmas Eve in 2024. The jury is expected to begin deliberations Thursday.

canada.title: Crown rests case in 1st-degree murder trial, jury told to come back in a week
canada.summary: Crown prosecutors Colin Sheppard and Alex Marshall are finished calling evidence in the first-degree murder trial of Matthew Kavanagh, Terry Cole and Stephanie Noftall. They are accused of killing 42-year-old Michael Fillier in Bay Roberts on Sept. 30, 2024.

canada.title: 21 arrested, 112 charges laid in probe of alleged towing-industry crime ring in GTA, police say
canada.summary: A probe targeting what police are calling an organized crime ring linked to Toronto's towing industry has led to 21 arrests, including the group's alleged leader who has ties to a towing company hired by Toronto police, investigators say.
canada.outlet: CBC News (CP), Global News, Nunatsiaq News

canada.title: EverWind says Cape Breton AI data centre project on track despite concerns
canada.summary: A representative of EverWind, the company behind a massive data centre project in Cape Breton, says everything is moving ahead as planned.
canada.outlet: Global News, Halifax Examiner, CBC News

canada.title: Police arrest roommate of 67-year-old man killed in Brossard
canada.summary: Police arrested a 44-year-old man after his 67-year-old roommate died in a homicide in Brossard, south of Montreal, Tuesday night.

canada.title: Quebec Bar Association wants new hotline, tax credit to improve access to justice
canada.summary: The professional order of lawyers in Quebec is proposing a new hotline as part of a range of measures to make legal services more accessible to members of the public.

canada.title: Canada's national emergency alert system will sound off Wednesday for testing
canada.summary: Canada's National Public Alerting System is running tests of its Alert Ready system Wednesday across all provinces and territories. Alert Ready delivers alerts about critical events such as tornadoes, flooding, fires and Amber alerts.

canada.title: Winnipeg police believe more victims were likely targeted in fake jewelry scams
canada.summary: Winnipeg police say they're looking for more victims after a number of elderly people were targeted in a fake jewelry scam last summer, but add a couple charged previously have been "removed from Canada" and their charges have been stayed.

canada.title: Explosion, fire destroy building in downtown Glace Bay and sends 14 to hospital
canada.summary: An explosion and large fire in downtown Glace Bay, N.S. has destroyed a building and sent 14 people to hospital.

canada.title: Calgary to explore new rules for data centres but temporary pause will go to public hearing
canada.summary: The move comes as a rezoning application is under review at city hall that would make way for a large-scale data centre in northeast Calgary.
